problem_statement: RIOT should provide a SenML subsystem with the public headers `senml/cbor.h`, `senml/phydat.h`, and `senml/saul.h`. It must define the SenML record types used by the API, including `senml_attr_t`, `senml_value_t`, `senml_bool_value_t`, `senml_string_value_t`, and `senml_data_value_t`, together with constructors such as `senml_duration_s`, `senml_float`, `senml_double`, `senml_int`, `senml_uint`, and `senml_decfrac`. The CBOR module must provide `senml_encode_value_cbor`, `senml_encode_bool_cbor`, `senml_encode_string_cbor`, `senml_encode_data_cbor`, and `senml_encode_sum_cbor`, which encode a SenML record into a NanoCBOR stream using the SenML label scheme, with optional sum, version, and update-time information included only when enabled. The Phydat module must provide `phydat_to_senml_float` and `phydat_to_senml_decimal`, converting a `phydat_t` dimension into a SenML value with the expected unit and numeric representation for compatible, converted, and unknown units, including the conversions exercised for time, Fahrenheit to Kelvin, gravity, bar to Pascal, gram per cubic metre to kilogram per cubic metre, and gauss to Tesla. The SAUL module must provide `senml_saul_encode_cbor`, which encodes a SAUL registry as a CBOR array of SenML records. `senml_unit_to_str` must return the SenML unit string for a given unit.

verification.reason: The statement names the types and functions but omits the concrete module names, compile-time macro names, struct field names, enum values, the numeric value union layout, and the saul encode signature that the hidden tests rely on. All gaps are public-interface details that can be specified without dictating the implementation.

problems.detail: The tests' Makefiles use USEMODULE += senml_cbor, senml_phydat, senml_saul. The statement refers to 'The CBOR module', 'The Phydat module', 'The SAUL module' but never gives the RIOT module names the agent must create.

The tests' Makefiles set CFLAGS += -DCONFIG_SENML_ATTR_SUM, -DCONFIG_SENML_ATTR_VERSION, -DCONFIG_SENML_ATTR_UPDATE_TIME. The statement says 'optional sum, version, and update-time information included only when enabled' but never names these macros.

The tests access struct fields by name: senml_attr_t has .base_name, .base_time, .update_time, .unit, .sum, .time, .base_version; senml_value_t has .attr and .value; senml_bool_value_t has .attr and .value; senml_string_value_t has .attr, .value, .len; senml_data_value_t has .attr, .value, .len. The statement names the types but not their fields.

The tests access senml_numeric_t members: .type (of type senml_value_type_t) and .value (a union with .u, .i, .f, .d, .df where .df has .e and .m). The statement never describes this structure or the union layout.

The tests use enum values SENML_TYPE_NUMERIC_INT, SENML_TYPE_NUMERIC_FLOAT, SENML_TYPE_NUMERIC_DOUBLE, SENML_TYPE_NUMERIC_UINT, SENML_TYPE_NUMERIC_DECFRAC (of type senml_value_type_t) and many SENML_UNIT_* values (SENML_UNIT_METER, SENML_UNIT_KILOGRAM, SENML_UNIT_SECOND, SENML_UNIT_NONE, SENML_UNIT_KELVIN, SENML_UNIT_MINUTE, SENML_UNIT_HOUR, SENML_UNIT_PASCAL, SENML_UNIT_TESLA, SENML_UNIT_KILOGRAM_PER_CUBIC_METER, SENML_UNIT_METER_PER_SQUARE_SECOND). The statement does not name the senml_unit_t or senml_value_type_t enums or their values.

The test calls senml_saul_encode_cbor(cbor_buf, sizeof cbor_buf, saul_reg) expecting a size_t return. The statement says 'encodes a SAUL registry as a CBOR array of SenML records' but does not give the signature (uint8_t *buf, size_t len, saul_reg_t *reg -> size_t).

The CBOR test compares against a fixed hex string that depends on the exact field ordering in the CBOR map (base_name, base_time, unit, update_time, value for the first record). The statement says 'using the SenML label scheme' but does not state the field emission order, so a different but semantically equivalent ordering would fail.

problem_statement_fixed: RIOT should provide a SenML subsystem with the public headers `senml/cbor.h`, `senml/phydat.h`, and `senml/saul.h`, buildable via the RIOT modules `senml_cbor`, `senml_phydat`, and `senml_saul` (each depending on a base `senml` module). It must define the SenML record types used by the API, including `senml_unit_t` (an enum of IANA-assigned SenML units and secondary units, at minimum including SENML_UNIT_NONE, SENML_UNIT_METER, SENML_UNIT_KILOGRAM, SENML_UNIT_SECOND, SENML_UNIT_KELVIN, SENML_UNIT_MINUTE, SENML_UNIT_HOUR, SENML_UNIT_PASCAL, SENML_UNIT_TESLA, SENML_UNIT_KILOGRAM_PER_CUBIC_METER, and SENML_UNIT_METER_PER_SQUARE_SECOND), `senml_value_type_t` (an enum with values SENML_TYPE_NUMERIC_UINT, SENML_TYPE_NUMERIC_INT, SENML_TYPE_NUMERIC_FLOAT, SENML_TYPE_NUMERIC_DOUBLE, SENML_TYPE_NUMERIC_DECFRAC), `senml_numeric_t` (containing a `type` field of type `senml_value_type_t` and a `value` union with members `u` (uint64_t), `i` (int64_t), `f` (float), `d` (double), and `df` (a struct with `e` (int32_t) and `m` (int32_t) fields)), `senml_attr_t` (containing fields `base_name`, `base_time`, `base_unit`, `base_value`, `name`, `unit`, `time`, and conditionally compiled fields `sum`, `base_sum`, `base_version`, and `update_time`), `senml_value_t` (containing `attr` of type `senml_attr_t` and `value` of type `senml_numeric_t`), `senml_bool_value_t` (containing `attr` and a `value` of type bool), `senml_string_value_t` (containing `attr`, a `value` pointer to const char, and a `len` of type size_t), and `senml_data_value_t` (containing `attr`, a `value` pointer to const uint8_t, and a `len` of type size_t). The sum, base_sum, base_version, and update_time fields of `senml_attr_t` are compiled in only when the macros `CONFIG_SENML_ATTR_SUM`, `CONFIG_SENML_ATTR_VERSION`, and `CONFIG_SENML_ATTR_UPDATE_TIME` are respectively defined. The constructors `senml_duration_s` (takes int64_t, returns senml_numeric_t), `senml_float` (takes float, returns senml_numeric_t), `senml_double` (takes double, returns senml_numeric_t), `senml_int` (takes int64_t, returns senml_numeric_t), `senml_uint` (takes uint64_t, returns senml_numeric_t), and `senml_decfrac` (takes int32_t m and int32_t e, returns senml_numeric_t) must create `senml_numeric_t` values of the appropriate type. The CBOR module must provide `senml_encode_value_cbor`, `senml_encode_bool_cbor`, `senml_encode_string_cbor`, `senml_encode_data_cbor`, and `senml_encode_sum_cbor`, each taking a `nanocbor_encoder_t *` and a pointer to the corresponding SenML value type, which encode a SenML record into a NanoCBOR stream using the SenML label scheme (labels per RFC 8428), with optional sum, version, and update-time information included only when the corresponding `CONFIG_SENML_ATTR_*` macro is defined. Fields must be emitted in the order: base_name, base_time, base_unit, base_value, base_sum, base_version, name, unit, sum, time, update_time, value/string_value/boolean_value/data_value. The Phydat module must provide `phydat_to_senml_float` and `phydat_to_senml_decimal`, each taking a `senml_value_t *`, a `const phydat_t *`, and a `uint8_t` dimension, converting a `phydat_t` dimension into a SenML value with the expected unit and numeric representation for compatible, converted, and unknown units, including the conversions exercised for time, Fahrenheit to Kelvin, gravity, bar to Pascal, gram per cubic metre to kilogram per cubic metre, and gauss to Tesla. The SAUL module must provide `senml_saul_encode_cbor` with signature `size_t senml_saul_encode_cbor(uint8_t *buf, size_t len, saul_reg_t *reg)`, which encodes all sensors in a SAUL registry as a CBOR array of SenML records and returns the encoded size. `senml_unit_to_str` must take a `senml_unit_t` and return the SenML unit string for a given unit.
